correctness.rationale: PASS. For all integers n>=2, the definition minimizes directed total domination over all orientations with positive indegree at each vertex. S is feasible exactly when it closed-dominates the original graph and every connected component of G[S] has an undirected cycle: each selected vertex needs a selected predecessor; conversely orient one cycle in every component, its attached forest outward and remaining S-to-complement edges outward. The upper witness consists of every middle-row vertex plus top-row vertices in columns 1,2, forming an induced square and dominating all vertices, size n+2. For lower bound write r occupied-column runs, e empty columns and b empty boundary columns. Cyclicity forces at least two columns with >=2 selected vertices per run, with extra surplus at boundary-occupied runs; hence surplus >=2r+b. Domination of empty columns gives e<=2(r-1)+b. Therefore |S|=(n-e)+surplus>=n+2; n=1 has no valid orientation and is explicitly excluded.
